Dear Sirs,  
 
We refer to our intimation dated May 17, 2026, informing about the conference call to be hosted by the 
Company on May 20, 2026 to discuss the financial results of the Company for the quarter and financial 
year ended March 31, 2026. 
 
In this connection, pursuant to the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, the Company has uploaded the audio recording of the 
conference call hosted by it on May 20, 2026, to discuss the financial results of the Company for the 
quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, on its website. The said audio recording can be 
accessed through the below mentioned web address: 
 
https://www.sammaancapital.com/call-and-recordings  
 
The transcript of the said conference call will be submitted, in due course. 
 
Please take the aforesaid intimation on record. 
  
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Sammaan Capital Limited
